event.summary: SEBI's interim order barred the company and its promoters over alleged diversion of borrowed funds and governance lapses; the share fell over 90%.
event.note: Promoter share pledges (over 80% of the promoters' holding by early 2025) were disclosed in the quarterly shareholding filings to the stock exchanges, not in this annual report, so our pledge check shows 'not found' here. Reading exchange filings is on our roadmap.

event.summary: After the founder's death in July 2019, investigations found Rs 3,535 crore had been moved from seven subsidiaries to Mysore Amalgamated Coffee Estates, a company controlled by the promoters; SEBI later fined the company Rs 26 crore.
SEBI's interim order alleged misstatements in the financial statements; a second order in August 2023 barred the chairman and CFO over fictitious accounting of share-issue money.
